headlines.title: Bird.com secures $450m financing as it launches communications infrastructure for AI agents
headlines.summary: AI communications infrastructure company Bird.com has completed a $450 million debt financing, led by J.P. Morgan, and unveiled a revamped Agentic Harness platform that now lets AI agents send messages, place calls, manage email, and even get their own eSIM phone plan on Bird's network without custom integration.

headlines.title: U.S. Card Issuers Delinquencies & NCOs Rise Sequentially in August
headlines.summary: U.S. card issuers saw August delinquencies and charge-offs rise sequentially, though both remained below year-ago levels. What does this mean for credit quality?

headlines.title: Banks warn AI shopping agents outpace fraud protections
headlines.summary: NatWest, Bank of America, and four other banks say consumers risk scams and data breaches as AI commerce tools advance faster than industry safeguards

headlines.title: Vinous Icons: Miami Returns November 12-14 with Over 100 Benchmark Estates
headlines.summary: Early-bird tickets are now on sale for Vinous Icons: Miami, presented by Capital One, returning for its third edition on November 12–14, 2026. The three-day program brings together more than 100 leading estates from Argentina, Chile, France, Italy, South Africa, Spain and the United States for two walk-around tastings, five masterclasses and two collector's events.

headlines.title: Prediction: The Next Big Bank Acquisition Is a Fintech, Not Another Bank
headlines.summary: Banks increasingly need technology and customers more than they need branches.

description: Capital One Financial Corporation operates as the financial services holding company for the Capital One, National Association, which engages in the provision of various financial products and services in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. It operates through three segments: Credit Card, Consumer Banking, and Commercial Banking. The company accepts checking accounts, money market deposits, negotiable order of withdrawals, savings deposits, time deposits, and sweep accounts. Its loan products include credit card and personal loans; auto and retail banking loans; and commercial and multifamily real estate, and commercial and industrial loans. The company offers credit and debit card products; bank lending; and provides advisory, capital markets, net interchange, treasury management, and depository services. It serves consumers, small businesses, and commercial clients through digital channels, branches, cafés, and other distribution channels located in New York, Louisiana, Texas, Maryland, Virginia, New Jersey, and the District of Columbia. Capital One Financial Corporation was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in McLean, Virginia.
